title: A U-match Algorithm for Persistent Relative Homology
summary: A central problem in data-driven scientific inquiry is how to interpret structure in noisy, high-dimensional data. Topological data analysis (TDA) provides a solution via persistent homology, which encodes features of interest as topological holes within a filtration of data. The present work extends this framework to a related invariant which uncovers topological structure of a space relative to a subspace: persistent relative homology (PRH).
